instructions.question: What overall sentiment does the tweet convey, through the author's feelings or through whether the reported news is good or bad?
instructions.rule: Judge the valence of the content, not just emotion words. Wins, records, honors, successes and promotional invitations are positive; delays, problems, defeats, penalties, injuries, attacks and scandals are negative. Routine personal plans, status updates, questions, plain stats, and playful or exaggerated grumbling about trivial things are neutral. A smiley, 'lol' or one dramatic phrase alone should not decide the label.

neutral.what: Routine plans, status updates, questions, stats without good or bad framing, and jokey or exaggerated complaints about trivial things.
examples: Purples and Football at Baby A's with my Aunt and Cousin. ready to see my JETS play on monday ;)
date: august 11th still no sign of frank ocean's new album. the world is turning on itself. buildings are burning. god refuses to comment.
Anyone wanna buy a Zac Brown Band ticket for the 3rd?
neutral.cues: going to, tomorrow, who's down, anyone, lol, haha, schedules
neutral.not_for: News of a clear success or a promo hyping an event (positive); reports of delays, problems or attacks (negative).

positive.what: Clear praise, love, excitement or pride; good news such as victories, records, awards or successes; promotions hyping an event or product.
examples: Ant-man tops North American box office: Marvel action flick ""Ant-Man"" stayed atop the US box office Sunday, ...
Saudi voters elect 20 women candidates for the 1st time: Two women were elected in Saudi Arabia's most conserv...
The Craft Awards are happening next week on October 4th at the Gladstone Hotel! Invite all your friends and get...
positive.cues: beats, tops, makes history, honored, join us, don't miss, can't wait, love, proud
positive.not_for: Ordinary plans with a smiley or 'lol' (neutral); excitement about someone losing or being hated (negative).

negative.what: Real complaints, insults, hostility, sadness or fear, and reports of bad events such as delays, problems, failures, penalties, injuries or attacks.
examples: SimCity delayed it’s availability
Problems for Newcastle Utd with new sponsor as star players may oppose Wonga's loans on religious ethical grounds
2nd time going to Dunkin today and there closed. Like no this is not ok
negative.cues: delayed, problems, penalty, fumble, hate, sucks, fuck, sad, boo, attack
negative.not_for: Playful exaggeration about trivial annoyances (neutral); condolences expressing warmth (positive).
